title: Yogurt chicken gravy
description: Yogurt-marinated chicken simmered with golden onions and tomato paste, finished with more yogurt, with flour tortillas used as chapati.
draft_note: Draft quantities: adjust them in the app. Marinate 30 minutes or overnight. Freeze the gravy only.

steps.text: Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces. Thinly slice the onions. Grate the ginger and garlic.
Mix half the yogurt with half the garam masala, the turmeric, chili powder and salt. Coat the chicken and marinate at least 30 minutes, or overnight in the fridge.
Heat the oil over medium heat and cook the onions until golden, about 10 minutes. Add the ginger, garlic, cumin and tomato paste and cook 2 minutes.
Add the chicken with its marinade and the water. Cover and simmer 15 to 18 minutes, stirring now and then, until the chicken is cooked through.
Take the pot off the heat for 1 minute, then stir in the remaining yogurt and garam masala so the yogurt doesn't split. Return to low heat for 2 minutes without boiling.
Warm each tortilla on a dry pan about 30 seconds per side, like chapati.
Divide the gravy among 4 containers, with 2 tortillas per serving packed separately.
Cool the gravy, then refrigerate. Keep the tortillas in their bag.
Reheat gently, stirring, so the yogurt sauce stays smooth. Warm the tortillas just before eating.
